findings.evidence: First ask: who reads this, what must they do, and what will they wrongly infer from the first two lines?
findings.fix: Keep the biggest-risk test (misread ask, accidental accusation, buried request, wrong register). Move the generic audience questions into skills/professional-communication/SKILL.md (its Audience and accuracy checks already cover recipient and desired outcome) and record the move in docs/audit/recovery/communication-excellence-coach/record.md.

findings.evidence: If the user cannot share the source text, say so and offer a checklist headed "Generic checklist (no draft reviewed)"
findings.fix: Keep the checklist as the no-draft fallback, and add one sentence that the review mindset (who reads this, what they must do, what the first two lines wrongly imply) is applied to every route, not only Review.

findings.evidence: Notification previews vary by client and may be off, so put the ask early in the message without relying on a one-line preview.
findings.fix: Keep the Slack-thread and Cc gotchas. Move the preview sentence into skills/professional-communication/SKILL.md next to its existing thread-notification gotcha, and record the move; a model already puts the ask first without being told previews vary.

findings.evidence: (4) resolved -> new concern, confused; if no plausible concern is left before the agreed count, the counterpart accepts and you end the roleplay early with the Coach Feedback.
findings.fix: Keep the four-branch picker. Add that the default three exchanges may end early only on branch (4) with no concern left, and that an unagreed count is three, so the stop condition is one default rather than a menu of endings.

findings.evidence: Feedback to deliver, no draft: written -> outline the SBI parts from their facts and ask for a draft to review; spoken -> outline the SBI parts and offer a roleplay.
findings.fix: Name the output of that branch: the written path returns the outlined SBI parts plus the one question and stops (Intake step 3); the spoken path returns the outlined SBI parts and then enters Roleplay only after the counterpart, goal and known reactions are present.

findings.evidence: The biggest risk is that gap (misread ask, accidental accusation, buried request, wrong register); fix it, then clarity and tone.
findings.fix: State the tie-break the template already implies: when the first two lines create more than one of those risks, quote and rewrite the misread ask first, then accusation, then buried request, then wrong register, and list each remaining risk under Suggestions with Category = risk.
